creator: leadwithzoe
title: Fo by Wajo (wajo.ai): AI phone/email agent that makes calls, sits on hold, books reservations, researches venues, with human backup assistants

tools.name: Fo (by Wajo)
tools.detail: wajo.ai; AI agent with its own phone number and email; message via app/phone/email; can be given a budget and credit card; human backup assistants join calls if callee refuses AI

claims: Free right now; creator expects it to get expensive once popular
Agent has its own phone number and email; can hold a budget and a credit card
Human backup assistants jump into the call if the other party won't talk to AI
Use 1: sat on hold over an hour for a refund, redialled after drops, navigated to a human
Use 2: called a restaurant to move a reservation to a slot not available online
Use 3: calling hotels/Airbnbs for a bachelorette party, collecting base prices into a spreadsheet, following up via email and text
how_to_steps: Sign up for Fo (Fo Mini free tier / 'OG Fo' invite only)
Message Fo a task from the app, or email it / CC it on a thread
Optionally set a budget and attach a card
Fo calls, texts, emails and reports back (e.g. asks to confirm a proposed alternative time)
on_screen_only: App text: 'Ask Fo to make calls for you -- from a dedicated number.' and 'Email Fo a task or CC it on any thread'

Pricing card: 'Fo Mini -- Free -- A little help, every day. Includes 1000 tasks per day(?), Your limit resets every day' and 'OG Fo -- Free, Invite only -- Everyday help, without the daily limit. Includes Unlimited tasks, Unlimited call time, Group chats with Fo'; handwritten note 'mini: daily limit / OG: invite only'
Call timer '0:19'; Fo message: 'He declined Tuesday and offered a partner call in three weeks. Thursday at 8:40 a.m. is open if you'll take breakfast near his office. Should I confirm?'
Spreadsheet of properties with highlighted rows; email thread screenshot
List overlay: 1. refunds 2. reservations 3. research & outreach
cta: Send this to your friend who is constantly on hold (caption)

relevance.why: Consumer admin-offloading tool, not a dev tool. Mildly useful for a time-poor founder's personal/VA tasks (vendor calls, appointments), and an interesting reference for voice-agent product design with human fallback.

implement_score.why: Try the free tier for a week of admin calls if it is available; no build work. Product-design takeaway: human-in-the-loop fallback is a strong trust feature for any agent product.
